assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is medically necessary to evaluate for arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms and to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular pathology.
The payer's denial under Reason Code CO-50 was based on the medical necessity requirements not being met.
The documented symptoms and clinical criteria directly support the necessity of this service.
